'''2014 Philadelphia Premiere Wayne Cullen LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Wayne Cullen]] at [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]].

* '''Player:''' [[Wayne Cullen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
